distributionCaveat: Goals are discrete and bounded. The Gaussian is a continuous forecast curve, not exact-score probabilities.
evidencePolicy: Archive exact original source bytes and SHA256, retrieval UTC time, selected record, raw decimal value, normalized WAD and canonical evidence JSON. Commit the keccak256 of that JSON. A hash proves integrity, not correctness.
field: home full-time goals + away full-time goals for Everton (home) vs Chelsea (away), Premier League 2026/27
initialForecastPolicy: The initial curve is a sponsor forecast, not bookmaker odds or an externally supplied probability. Every later curve is read from confirmed onchain state.
missingData: If officially rescheduled to kick off earlier than closeAt, abandoned, cancelled, not completed, not marked FT by resolveBy, or the result is outside 0–30, do not resolve. Anyone cancels at expiry and all original deposits are refunded. A postponement to after closeAt is admissible only if FT is published before resolveBy.
publicationPolicy: Use the first official Premier League FT result for this exact fixture completed after the committed closeAt. Count regulation and stoppage-time goals only. Ignore subsequent disciplinary/administrative score changes. Retain the official match page URL and screenshot/source bytes in evidence.
question: Everton vs Chelsea · total goals
resolverModel: Trusted project operator reports the official score; no live score feed or decentralized sports oracle is claimed.
rounding: Normalize once, then round to the nearest outcomeStep. Exact halves round away from zero.
